europe_now.title: Energy Pressures from Middle East Conflicts
europe_now.summary: Ongoing conflicts in the Middle East are threatening Europe with the prospect of another major energy crisis. Analysts and reports indicate that these geopolitical tensions could severely disrupt fuel and power supplies across the continent.

sources.headline: Middle East conflicts push Europe toward a second energy crisis in five years

europe_now.title: Security Concerns Surrounding German Far-Right Party
europe_now.summary: Political and security discussions in Germany are intensifying regarding whether the far-right Alternative for Germany party should be barred from sensitive intelligence access. Critics and officials have raised alarms about potential foreign influence risks linked to the party.

sources.headline: ‘Russian sleeper cell’: Can Germany’s far-right AfD be barred from sensitive intel?

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has been visiting France, drawing massive crowds for open-air religious services in Paris and traveling to Lourdes. During his tour, the pontiff has addressed youth gatherings and scheduled meetings with survivors of clergy sexual abuse.

sources.headline: Live: Pope Leo XIV to hold open-air mass in Lourdes pilgrimage site

top_stories.title: European Energy Pressures
top_stories.summary: Escalating conflicts originating in the Middle East are placing renewed strain on European energy markets and infrastructure. Observers warn that the continent faces the risk of experiencing its second significant energy crisis in the span of five years.
